HOMEBREW STORE for Miyoo Mini / Mini Plus (Onion OS)
====================================================

Browse and install free, legal homebrew games for Game Boy, Game Boy Color,
Game Boy Advance and NES from Homebrew Hub (https://hh.gbdev.io).

INSTALL
  Copy the HomebrewStore folder to  SD:/App/HomebrewStore
  It appears under Apps in Onion. Wi-Fi must be on.

CONTROLS
  Browse      Up/Down move · Left/Right page · L1/R1 platform
              L2/R2 type (Games/Demos/Music/Tools/Everything)
              A details · X install · Y search · SELECT sort · START refresh
              B or MENU quit
  Details     A install · Y remove · L1/R1 screenshots · Up/Down scroll text
              L2/R2 previous/next game · B back
  Search      A type · B delete · X space · SELECT clear · START done

WHERE THINGS GO
  Games       Roms/GB, Roms/GBC, Roms/GBA, Roms/FC (NES)
  Box art     Roms/<system>/Imgs/<game>.png
  Cache       App/HomebrewStore/cache (safe to delete)

TROUBLESHOOTING
  Picture upside down?  Create an empty file named "norotate" in this folder.
  Errors are written to log.txt in this folder.

Fonts: Atkinson Hyperlegible and Press Start 2P, SIL Open Font License (res/).
Catalog and games: Homebrew Hub by gbdev; each game keeps its own license.
